milestones.title: Enquiry received
milestones.criterion: EXAMPLE ONLY: this SOP is a labeled example for testing and demonstration, not a company standard; replace it before real use. Cited evidence shows a customer asking for a price or a service for a described shipment.

milestones.title: Scope of work understood
milestones.criterion: Cited evidence states the origin, the destination, the mode and the goods well enough to price the work. Name any open question in the memo instead of assuming an answer.

milestones.title: Costs obtained
milestones.criterion: Cited evidence shows a rate or a cost from every supplier needed to price the work, or records why one is still missing.

milestones.title: Quote sent to customer
milestones.criterion: Cited evidence shows the priced offer reaching the customer, with its validity date when the offer states one.

milestones.title: Customer answered the quote
milestones.criterion: Cited evidence shows the customer accepting, declining or asking for a change. Silence past the validity date is not an answer; judge it pending and say what is waited on.

milestones.title: Booking confirmed by customer
milestones.criterion: Cited evidence shows the customer instructing the work to proceed, in writing or as a recorded account of a verbal instruction.

milestones.title: Commercial terms agreed
milestones.criterion: Cited evidence states the agreed price, the incoterm and the payment terms, or names which of them is still open.

milestones.title: Carrier space booked
milestones.criterion: Cited evidence shows a carrier accepting the booking and issuing its own reference. Record that reference as an external reference; it is not this booking.

milestones.title: Schedule confirmed
milestones.criterion: Cited evidence gives the planned departure and arrival. A planned date is an estimate and is never judged as an actual occurrence.

milestones.title: Shipper instructed
milestones.criterion: Cited evidence shows the collection or delivery instruction reaching the party who must act on it, not only that it was written.

milestones.title: Cargo collected
milestones.criterion: Cited evidence shows the goods leaving the collection address. A signed driver receipt is stronger evidence than a planning document.

milestones.title: Export documents ready
milestones.criterion: Cited evidence shows every export document this route needs is in hand and matches the cargo description.

milestones.title: Export customs cleared
milestones.criterion: Cited evidence shows the export authority releasing the goods. A lodged declaration is not yet a release.

milestones.title: Departed origin
milestones.criterion: Cited evidence shows the vessel, aircraft or truck leaving with these goods on board.

milestones.title: Arrived at destination point
milestones.criterion: Cited evidence shows the goods reaching the destination port, airport or terminal.

milestones.title: Import customs cleared
milestones.criterion: Cited evidence shows the import authority releasing the goods to the consignee or their broker.

milestones.title: Delivered
milestones.criterion: Cited evidence shows the consignee receiving the goods. A proof of delivery names who signed and when; arrival at a terminal does not prove delivery.

milestones.title: Charges settled
milestones.criterion: Cited evidence shows every charge invoiced and any dispute either resolved or named as still open.
